claim.quote: A profile likelihood analysis using an energy range of (6.6 - 43.3) keV$_{\mathrm{nr}}$ sets a limit on the elastic, spin-independent WIMP-nucleon scattering cross section for WIMP masses above 8 GeV/$c^2$, with a minimum of 1.1 $\times 10^{-45}$ cm$^2$ at 50 GeV/$c^2$ and 90% confidence level.

key_value.quote: with a minimum of 1.1 $\times 10^{-45}$ cm$^2$ at 50 GeV/$c^2$ and 90% confidence level

name: XENON100 Dark Matter Results from a Combination of 477 Live Days

summary.plain: XENON100's final WIMP search combined three runs, 477 live days in all, and again found no dark matter.
summary.technical: Three runs summing to 477 live days (January 2010 - January 2014), exposure 48 kg x yr, blind analysis of the last run (April 2013 - January 2014); spin-independent minimum 1.1e-45 cm^2 at 50 GeV/c^2; spin-dependent WIMP-neutron (proton) minimum 2.0e-40 cm^2 (52e-40 cm^2) at 50 GeV/c^2, 90% CL.

title: XENON100 Dark Matter Results from a Combination of 477 Live Days
why_it_matters: The complete XENON100 WIMP-search result, with updated spin-dependent constraints.
